First go to https://8ch.net/qresearch/catalog.html

This is the "Catalog". The "boxes" you see are called "breads". Each "bread" can have about 751 "comments" on it before getting "locked". They may talk about "the bread getting eaten fast" when too many comments come in at once. "Bakers" make the next "bread" as they reach the limit for replies. Look for the boxes with the title in RED that say "Welcome to Q Research General". This is where Q has been posting lately, and the anons share their research. Notice they each have a # and a "bread title". The newest number is the only one where you can post, it will be near the top of the page. The older numbers are "closed". Only a certain number of "boxes/breads" will fit on the page, so the oldest ones "roll off" the bottom and appear to be lost forever. At the top of each box will be an R: number, like R:388. That means this "bread" already has 388 replies, so has room for quite a few more replies, before maxing out at 751.

Click on a "Welcome to Q Research General" box. There is a lot of useful "general information" posted at the top of EVERY bread.

Scroll down a bit to the "Notables" section. Though there may be 751 replies below Notables in each bread, a lot of it is "thank you", naked women or other porn (usually shills trying to scare people off so they won't come back), responses to trolls, etc. SOME of it is good stuff, research by anons, memes and such, and the "baker" collects the good stuff and summarizes it in the "notables" for the next few "breads". You can hover over the number to preview, or click the number to go to that post. If you merely want to quickly browse through the threads, go to the bottom of the Notables, check the # for the last set of notables, then go back to the Catalog and search for that # and you can read all the Notables without having to scroll the 751 replies to each thread/bread.

You can only reply in the current thread/bread. For the post you want to reply to, it will have a number, such as No.4287465. Click on the number and a Quick Reply dialog box will appear; the post number you are replying to will be pre-populated. DO NOT FILL OUT NAME, EMAIL OR SUBJECT, LEAVE THEM BLANK. ALWAYS. ALWAYS. ALWAYS. If you try to reply in a "closed" bread, it will give an error message. Copy your reply, add pb after the number (to indicate this is a reply to a "previous bread" or lb (to indicated this is a reply to the "last bread". Then go to the current "bread" and copy it into the comment box at the top. It will automatically make the >> number into a link and add your post to the bottom of the current "bread".
